entries.title: Psalms 47:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.>> O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph. {for: or, of}

entries.title: Psalms 47:2
segments: For the LORD most high [is] terrible; [he is] a great King over all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 47:3
segments: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:4
segments: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 47:5
segments: ¶God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:6
segments: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

entries.title: Psalms 47:7
segments: For God [is] the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding. {with: or, every one that hath}

entries.title: Psalms 47:8
segments: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 47:9
segments: The princes of the people are gathered together, [even] the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth [belong] unto God: he is greatly exalted. {princes...: or, voluntary of the people are gathered unto the people of the God of Abraham}

words.text: . {princes...: or, voluntary of the people are gathered unto the people of the God of Abraham}
